cabin-methow-lodge.title: Log cabin with hot tub, sleeps 8 - Winthrop, WA
bullets: House rules: no smoking, no pets, quiet hours 22:00-08:00
cabin-methow-lodge.description: Price per night. Hand-built log cabin on ten acres in the Methow with a hot tub on the deck, a games loft and a big farmhouse table. Cross-country ski trails start at the property line in winter. Cleaning fee $180; 2-night minimum.

reviews.author: alice
reviews.title: The whole team fit
reviews.body: Ten of us for the offsite and nobody was on a sofa. Sunset from the top deck every night, and the fire pit was the meeting room.

reviews.author: carol
reviews.title: Better than the hotel
reviews.body: Stayed here for the DevCon week instead of the conference hotel. Quieter, cheaper, and the rooftop at sunset was the best part of the trip.

reviews.author: alice
reviews.title: Stars, tub, silence
reviews.body: Exactly the point of going. Dropped a star because the solar ran low on the second cloudy evening, which the hosts warn you about.
